releaseNotes: Fixes a false live-text interruption when an empty editor drops its initial paragraph marker.
Adds local session timings and numeric insertion traces, without logging dictated words, clipboard contents or audio.
Faster previews update only the changed tail; Apple Terminal uses agreeing-word appends.
Recover the last 10 non-secure dictations from the island; history clears when Saylo quits.
Result cards fade after four seconds, pause on hover, and dismiss after a dispatched Paste.
